The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f38734b35e639f88), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 12-13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Fix a finite field radius R and positive fixed error tolerances. There are sufficiently small constants ptop, s0 > 0 such that the following hold with probability tending to one in the range np3 ≥ c √ log n and p ≤ ptop. Spectral and spherical estimates, at every scale. The spectral dimension satisfies dim Hp ≍ kp, d1 ≥ −o(p2) uniformly in the cap range, and Tr R2 p,0 = O(n/p). On |α| ≤ s0p2, ℓp(α) ≍ p2Mp and ℓ′ p(α) ≍ Mp. For ∥h∥ ≤ Rp2Mp, the saddle precision has gap comparable to p2. At α = αp(h), the density at n of the squared norm of N(Rp,αh, Rp,α) is comparable to p p/n. After multiplication by evTX and renormalization, the Gaussian mean becomes Rp,α(h + v) while its covariance remains Rp,α; its squared-norm density at n is at most a fixed multiple of p p/n. For m replicas, where m is fixed, consider rowwise linear or quadratic tilts that preserve Gaussianity. The joint density of their squared norms is at most Cm(p/n)m/2 under the following hypotheses. The spectral rows remain independent after the rowwise tilt, the tilted precision is positive definite, and on at least ckp rows the post-tilt row covariance Ca satisfies cp−2 Idm ⪯ Ca ⪯ Cp−2 Idm. All comparison constants here are fixed. 12 Curvature estimates, at every scale. On the annulus, for any prescribed fixed ϵ0 > 0, Kp ⪯ (1 + ϵ0)p−2 IdHp , p2 (Kp)ee ≤ 1 − ϵ1, e = h/∥h∥, ϵ1 = 0.1. (2.11) On the entire field ball one also has Kp ⪯ CRp−2 IdHp , where CR may be chosen before ϵ0.
